Telos.

Telos is a zero-dependency local workbench for creating, simulating, and replaying AI work. Its CLI and MCP servers expose workstation checks, creative simulations, research proofs, model and learning experiments, and browser or Windows automation, with a re-checkable receipt for each run.

Limitations and authorization boundaries

  • Pre-1.0 interfaces may change.
  • A research packet does not by itself prove causal discovery, robot safety, or hardware fault-tolerance claims.

Authorization boundary. Workstation actions and external effects remain subject to explicit operator authority and tool-specific gates.
